🎥🍿: Children of Blood and Bone (2027)

After magic is stolen from the kingdom of Orïsha, a young woman named Zélie embarks on a perilous mission to restore it before a ruthless king wipes out the last hope for her people. Along the way, unexpected allies, dangerous enemies, and powerful secrets shape the fate of the entire kingdom.

As the journey grows more dangerous, Zélie must learn to embrace her powers while those closest to the king begin questioning everything they’ve been taught. With the future of Orïsha hanging in the balance, every choice brings them one step closer to an unforgettable showdown.

source_details.title: Children of Blood and Bone
source_details.synopsis: Children of Blood and Bone is an upcoming American fantasy film directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood, who co-wrote the screenplay with Tomi Adeyemi, based on the 2018 novel by Adeyemi. The film stars Thuso Mbedu, Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, Cynthia Erivo, Lashana Lynch, Zackary Momoh, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Regina King, Idris Elba, and Viola Davis. Children of Blood and Bone is scheduled to be released by Paramount Pictures in the United States on January 15, 2027.
